identity: One orange jet boat: angular chamfered hull, blue trim stripes, grey-white stern jet housing with dark nozzle, JET badge on port stern, grey grab rails, dark cockpit, black lower hull
Exactly two crew seen from behind: port = dark brown spiky hair, starboard = blond swept hair; both yellow life vests with dark straps over blue shirts, dark gloves on handlebars
Red blocky stratified sandstone canyon with green plateau tops, flat-crowned trees, hanging vines
Turquoise river with white foam; grey boulders, ferns, broad leaves and pink flowers on the banks
materials: Stylized smooth shading with crisp chamfered planes, soft painterly gradients, no photoreal grit
Rock: large flat facets, horizontal strata, lit orange tops vs red shadow sides
Water: glossy turquoise with sky fresnel, soft caustic-like light ripples, thick white foam
Boat: semi-gloss paint with clear highlights
lighting: High warm sun from upper-left/behind-left; cool blue sky fill; warm bounce on rock; soft contact shadows; light aerial haze shifting far mesas to pink
camera: Perspective chase camera behind and slightly above/left of the boat, ~55 deg vertical FOV; boat ~27% of frame width, centered slightly left and below middle; horizon at ~47% from top; boat banks in turns
ui: Top-left circular teal emblem (sun over three wave lines) with timer plate beneath in lavender digits; left-edge SCORE panel in navy with slanted blue accent bar and cream bold digits; top-right skewed SPEED card with glowing cyan outline, white glowing number and KM/H chip. Rounded bold geometric sans.
motion: Authored (unobserved): weighty planing hull, bank into turns, bow lift under throttle, big rooster-tail and side spray, bobbing on waves, punchy landings
nonnegotiables: Orange boat + two yellow-vested crew is the focal accent
Turquoise water against red sandstone complementary contrast
Rear three-quarter chase framing with foliage/rock framing the edges
HUD family: emblem+timer, SCORE panel, cyan SPEED card in the same positions
White spray around the hull while moving
avoid: Neon sci-fi UI beyond the cyan speed card
Replacing the crew with primitives lacking hair/vest identity
deliberate_changes: Race position chip and boost meter added in the same HUD family (authored, not in reference)
All geometry procedural rather than sculpted/generated: simpler silhouettes, less painterly micro-detail than the still
